description: Get pump-and-dump manipulation risk signals across crypto assets. Scores combine derivatives pressure, holder concentration, liquidity quality, DEX flow, and price behavior; read score_interpretation: a score missing funding, price or derivatives inputs is a conservative lower bound, while missing on-chain inputs are re-weighted and listed in incomplete_signal_groups. oi_change_24h, return_24h and the other shares and changes are fractions (0.054 = 5.4%). coin returns one coin's row as the scorer wrote it, dated by its own updated_at (score null and stale once it stopped qualifying).

coin.description: One coin by its CoinGecko id (e.g. pepe): its row exactly as the scorer wrote it, whatever its score, and the answer is dated by that row's own `updated_at`. A coin that stopped qualifying answers `score: null` with its sub-scores and phase cleared, keeps the other inputs of its last qualifying run, and reads stale with a warning; an id with no row answers an empty list. `limit`, `min_score` and `phase` do not apply.

limit.description: Maximum number of coins to return.

min_score.description: Filter to coins scoring at or above this value.

phase.description: Filter to one manipulation phase label.

name: get_pump_dump

basis_rate_avg.description: Mean perp basis across venues, a fraction. Null outside the futures-covered majors (the only coins with stored basis).

cvd_trend_24h.description: Taker CVD trend over the newest 24 hourly candles, -1 to 1. Null outside the futures-covered majors (the only coins with taker-split candles).

holders_change.description: Fraction (0.07 = +7%): relative change between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart). Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

liquidity_change.description: Fraction (0.07 = +7%): relative change between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart). Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

oi_change_24h.description: Fraction (0.07 = +7%): 24 h change of the coin's USD-notional open interest over the contracts with a reading 24-28 h before their latest (MEXC excluded), computed as `/v1/global/overview` computes `oiChange24h`. USD, so a price move alone moves it.

return_24h.description: Price return over 24 h, a fraction (0.054 = +5.4%), from the tracker cache (refreshed every few hours, accepted up to 24 h old), not measured by the scoring run.

return_7d.description: Price return over 7 days, a fraction, from the tracker cache (refreshed every few hours, accepted up to 24 h old), not measured by the scoring run.

signal_coverage.description: Weighted completeness of the score's inputs over the funding, price, derivatives and on-chain groups, 0 to 1 (0.81 is 81%).

top10_holders_share.description: Share of supply held by the 10 largest holders of the coin's main contract, 0 to 1 (0.3553 is 35.53%). Null when unknown. On Pump & Dump it is also null when contracts (treasury Safes, vesting, bridges, pools) hold over half of that top-10 share; Insider Selling keeps that share, since treasury and vesting supply is insider supply. Exchange hot wallets count as holders on both.

top10_holders_share_change.description: The difference of the two most recent distinct `top10_holders_share` readings: 0.012 is a share up from 0.300 to 0.312, not a relative change. Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

volume_change.description: Fraction (0.07 = +7%): relative change between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart). Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Pump and dump detection
